layered.purpose: Independent FMM candidate paths followed by continuous variational bending, with optional exact production-entry parity
limitations: Finite seeds and auxiliary grids do not certify global first arrival.
FMM field time is not used as the reported continuous travel time.
Nondifferentiability at an exact branch crossing requires separate one-sided interpretation.
No field model has been reinverted with this prototype.

oblique.purpose: Invented positive 3-D affine-velocity fields, exact contained circular geodesics, and unchanged continuous bending of FMM seeds.
limitations: This smooth affine field has a known unconstrained first-arrival geodesic entirely inside the box; it does not test a competing direct/diving branch or heterogeneous caustic.
Both the FMM-bent candidate and selected minimum over straight/FMM seeds are tested; a correct direct seed cannot hide an inaccurate FMM-bent candidate.
The existing 2.5e-5 s time, 3e-6 s/km endpoint-derivative, and 2e-5 s reciprocity tolerances are retained.
Auxiliary and path refinement are separate variants. All numerical failures remain saved.
Only the declared bounded controls are assessed; no general first-arrival or convergence certificate.
First-arrival child runners differ solely by an added frozen helper dependency.
No historical full-cohort numerical equivalence or new inverse acceptance is asserted.
